faq.title: What people ask before writing to us.
faq.imageAlt: Illustration of construction cranes in orange tones on a pink background

items.question: How much does it cost?
items.answer: It depends on what needs solving. After the first call we send you a price in writing, before any work starts. If it makes sense, we start with a small piece and build from there.

items.question: How long does it take?
items.answer: It depends on the scope. The delivery date goes in the written proposal, and in the meantime you see progress every week.

items.question: What happens to the tools we already use?
items.answer: We start from them. If your spreadsheets, invoicing or WhatsApp work for you, we connect them instead of replacing them. If data has to move to a new system, that goes into the proposal.

items.question: Do we have to replace our whole system?
items.answer: Not necessarily. Often it's enough to fix one part, like inventory, bookings or a single integration. We look at it on the first call.

items.question: I don't know what I need. Can we still talk?
items.answer: Yes. Tell us what eats up your time or what keeps slipping, and we'll work out together where to start.

sistemas-de-gestion.metaTitle: Custom management systems for small businesses
sistemas-de-gestion.metaDescription: Inventory, orders, sales or bookings in one system built around how your business works. Scope and price in writing before we start.
sistemas-de-gestion.lead: Inventory, orders, sales or bookings in one place, built around how your business works. Stop fighting spreadsheets that no longer hold.

sections.title: What we solve.
sections.body: A system shaped around your operation: inventory control, orders, sales, bookings or whatever slips between chats and spreadsheets today. We build it for how your team works, not the other way around.

sections.title: A real example: EventOps.
sections.body: That is how we built EventOps for event companies: our own product in production that keeps day-to-day operations in order. Every business is different, but the approach is the same: understand how you work and build around that.

sections.title: Who it is for.
sections.body: For small businesses with inventory, orders or bookings that still run on Excel, WhatsApp or an old system. If the owner or ops lead feels they waste time entering the same data twice, we start there.

sistemas-de-gestion.ctaTitle: Has your operation outgrown a spreadsheet?
sistemas-de-gestion.ctaDescription: Tell us how you work today. We reply with scope and price in writing before we start.

webs-y-catalogos.metaTitle: Websites, booking and catalogs for shops
webs-y-catalogos.metaDescription: A website for your business, online booking or a catalog with WhatsApp ordering. Customers find you and get in touch.
webs-y-catalogos.lead: A clear website for your business, online booking or a catalog with WhatsApp ordering. Customers find you, see what you offer and get in touch.

sections.title: What we solve.
sections.body: Concrete digital presence: a landing that explains what you do, a booking flow so people schedule themselves, or a catalog with WhatsApp ordering. No platforms that take your margin, no templates that do not look like your business.

sections.title: How we build it.
sections.body: We start from how you want people to find you and reach out. The result is clear, fast and easy to maintain: a site that explains what you do, a booking tool that runs itself or a catalog ready for WhatsApp orders.

sections.title: Who it is for.
sections.body: For shops and small businesses that need customers to find them online, book a slot or order on WhatsApp without jumping through hoops.

webs-y-catalogos.ctaTitle: Can customers not find you online?
webs-y-catalogos.ctaDescription: Tell us what you want to show or sell. We reply with scope and price in writing.

bots-con-ia.metaTitle: AI bots and agents for businesses
bots-con-ia.metaDescription: A bot or agent that answers around the clock on WhatsApp or your site: it takes orders, books appointments or answers questions. When a person is needed, it hands it to you.
bots-con-ia.lead: A bot or agent that answers around the clock on WhatsApp, your website or wherever your customers are. It takes orders, books appointments or answers questions. When something needs a person, it hands it to you.

sections.title: What we solve.
sections.body: The repeated questions that eat your day: hours, prices, stock, open slots. The bot answers what it can and escalates what it cannot. AI where it pays off, not for show.

sections.title: Where it lives.
sections.body: On WhatsApp, on your site or on the channel where people already write to you. It connects to what you already use: your calendar, catalog or spreadsheet. You do not need to replace everything to start.

sections.title: Who it is for.
sections.body: For businesses that get a lot of questions and cannot reply on time. If your team spends hours on the same answers every day, a well-built bot takes that load off.

bots-con-ia.ctaTitle: Do the same questions land all day?
bots-con-ia.ctaDescription: Tell us which questions eat your time. We reply with scope and price in writing.

integraciones.metaTitle: Integrations between the tools you already use
integraciones.metaDescription: We connect WhatsApp, spreadsheets and invoicing. Enter something once and it shows up where it should. Scope in writing before we start.
integraciones.lead: We connect WhatsApp, your spreadsheets and invoicing to each other. Enter something once and it shows up where it should. Without tearing down what already works.

sections.title: What we solve.
sections.body: Data that moves by hand from one place to another: a WhatsApp order you later type into a spreadsheet, a sale you invoice separately. We connect those pieces so the data is entered once.

sections.title: How we approach it.
sections.body: We start from the tools you already use. If they work, we connect them. If something needs replacing, it is clear in the proposal. The goal is less friction, not a new system for its own sake.

sections.title: Who it is for.
sections.body: For teams juggling several tools and losing time moving the same information around. Ideal if you do not want to change everything at once.
